# Imported after a_usd_arrival_booked_to_the_directors_account.txt: 1,000.00
# of the arrival's dollars converted into 900.00 EUR, drawn on the arrival's
# cost basis and opening a euro cost basis, and a fee of 1.00 EUR drawn on that
# and 0.10 USD drawn on the arrival's.
#
# The euro fee draws on the conversion, and the conversion on the arrival. So
# the arrival can be deleted only once both are gone, the euro fee first: a
# refused edit of the arrival gives one `delete-transactions --by-guid`
# command deleting the arrival's own fee, the euro fee, the conversion and the
# arrival, in that order, listing the euro fee once though it draws on both.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_an_edit_may_move_the_split_that_sets_the_rate.py.
